verdict: Claude Haiku 5.5, or Claude Sonnet 5.5 for the most accuracy on invoices. On W-2 forms both caught every error when a reviewer checks the 30% of values with the lowest confidence (AUROC 0.98 and 0.99), at about the default's cost for Claude Haiku 5.5. On RealKIE invoices Claude Sonnet 5.5 caught 87% of errors that way (AUROC 0.92) against 66% for Claude Haiku 5.5 (0.81), for about $104 more per 1,000 invoices. The default, Amazon Nova Lite, caught 14% to 19%: fewer than reviewing values at random (30%).
